messages.subject: Hot honey jars leaking
messages.body:
Hi Odile,

Our delivery this morning had 4 of the 12 jars of Ridgeback chili hot honey leaking at the lid. Sticky mess all over the case and two of the labels are ruined. Lot code on the jars is L-2207. Can we get those credited? The other 8 look ok for now but I'm keeping an eye on them.

Thanks,
Nell
Pickering & Daughters Deli

messages.subject: Re: Hot honey jars leaking

So sorry about that. I'll credit the 4 jars on your next invoice. Could you keep the bad ones aside in case the producer wants photos? I'll look into what happened.

Odile

messages.body:
Hello Odile,

This is the third case of the chili hot honey where the lids are weeping. Customers have brought back two jars this week because the outside was sticky. The lot is L-2207 on all of them. We'd like to pull it from the shelf until you can tell us what's going on, and we'd rather not reorder until it's sorted.

Regards,
Maeve Tran
Buyer, Hollis Corner Grocer

messages.subject: Lid issue on batch L-2207
messages.body:
Hi Odile,

Heads up from our side. Our lid supplier told us yesterday that the lids used on our batch L-2207 had a faulty liner, so some jars may not seal fully, especially after a bumpy truck ride. The honey itself is fine. We can either send you 300 replacement lids with relabel kits, or credit the whole lot at cost. Could you tell me how many L-2207 jars you still have in stock and which option you'd prefer?

Really sorry about this.
Ines
Ridgeback Apiary

messages.body:

messages.subject: Re: Warm dairy on Tuesday
messages.body:
Odile, scratch that. Turns out our receiving thermometer was broken. We probed everything again with a new one and the dairy was at 3°C. No credit needed, all good.

Owen

messages.body:

Kieran

opportunities.what: Nell, Dario and Maeve all report leaking hot honey lids from lot L-2207; Ines confirms a faulty lid batch and offers replacement lids or a full credit, and Teodor still holds 9 cases. Pull the stock, take Ridgeback's credit or lids, and send the three customers one fix-and-credit reply.

Verdant Groves raised the 5-liter olive oil tin from 41.00 to 44.50 to 47.80 over three invoices, while Calderón quotes 42.00 for the same grade. Prepare a price comparison and renegotiate with Verdant or move the next order.
Fernhill (due Dec 7) and Brightwater both need allergen info for the gift box items, and Joy has every producer spec sheet. Compile one allergen matrix for both boxes and send it to both customers.

The food safety inspection on Thursday Dec 3 covers both walk-in cold rooms, but cold room 2 will be empty and powered down for the compressor swap that same day. Move the swap or warn the inspector and prepare the records.
Dad's 70th dinner is Saturday Dec 12, inside the Dec 11-13 cabin booking with Saskia; dates change free only until Dec 1. Move the cabin dates now and tell Saskia.
Mom lands at Northgate at 2:10 pm and Uncle Théo at 3:05 pm on Tuesday Dec 22. Plan one airport pickup for both and tell them.

traps.what: Two people with the first name Priya (Natarajan at a restaurant, Okafor at a freight carrier) both mention Tuesday, but an order move and a dock pickup time are unrelated.
Bellwether is a cheese from Tollgate Creamery and also the street of a new restaurant; the shared word links nothing.
Teodor needs an extra refrigerated van for December, and a neighbor is selling a refrigerated van in personal mail; joining work and personal threads is out of bounds.
A truck temperature alert and a warm-dairy complaint looked linked, but the logger was faulty and the customer withdrew the credit request.
The anchovy producer gives no date for new-season stock and Tomasz just wants a heads-up; any deadline would be invented, and the single reply to Tomasz already covers it.
Fair stall and jam samples for the Riverbend fair on October 24, which passed more than 30 days ago.
Two late-delivery complaints are the same customer, Hugo Brandt, writing from his shop and his personal address.
Rising vanilla prices show up only in trade newsletters and a price digest.
Ada and Liam both asked about holiday deliveries, but the open to-do from Magnus's message already covers one schedule for all customers.
